The '''Vixe Estate''' was a large residence owned by [[Rae Vixe]]. He threw an extravagant gala to celebrate the [[Harvest Season]] at the estate, which was attended by hundreds of guests.<ref name="FB">{{WEGCite|book=Instant Adventures|story=Family Problems}}</ref>
